lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance circular spots is visible, arranged in approximately five horizontal rows and multiple vertical columns across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated intensity intersect with horizontal ridges to form a matrix where circular spots act as nodal points at each intersection.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank, characterized by a high-contrast luminance gradient with light-toned upper edges and shadowed lower boundaries.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of small high-luminance spots, with higher density observed near the base and anterior margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct high-luminance comma-shaped mark is present on the mid-lateral flank, ventral to the primary spot grid. Minor irregularities are visible on the leading edge of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A small elongated organism is attached to the ventral-posterior region of the shark.
